title: build(deps-dev): bump @types/three from 0.185.4 to 0.186.0
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. Typings-only devDependency @types/three 0.185.4 -> 0.186.0 in packages/client; closes the known lag recorded in three-0.186.1-bump.json (runtime three is already ^0.186.1). Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001).
behavior_change: none in the shipped app: @types/* is compile-time only and is not bundled. Branch merged with origin/main c3383d56 (after sibling bumps #431 supabase-js and #432 @types/node landed on adjacent lines); the conflict was resolved by taking main's package.json and package-lock.json and applying only the @types/three delta. Lockfile audited against c3383d56 by parsing both trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full: 400 entries before and after, zero added, zero removed, exactly 1 node_modules entry changed: @types/three 0.185.4 -> 0.186.0 (version, resolved, integrity, and its own range fflate ~0.8.2 -> ~0.8.3), byte-for-byte equal to the entry Dependabot generated at 7781b91b. The fflate range change moves nothing: node_modules/fflate resolves to 0.8.3 before and after. The root entry differs only in devDependencies.@types/three. The 16 peer-flag-only entries in Dependabot's original lockfile were npm-version normalization noise and are dropped, matching the convention set by #432 (ec88eedd reverted the same churn). Sibling versions preserved at HEAD: @types/node 26.6.5, @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.2, vue-tsc 3.3.12. Consumers: components/cam/ToolpathCanvas3D.vue (live) and components/cam/CamBackplot3D.vue import three.
